rationale: No supported optimization applies without weakening coverage or adding unsupported risk. The workflow already caches pip dependencies via actions/setup-python@v6 with cache: "pip", so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated (an equivalent dependency cache already exists); the Python P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE experiment only measured a benefit where no cache existed. The matrix intentionally tests compatibility across Python 3.10–3.15, so every matrix outcome is required and switching fail-fast from false to true (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) would reduce required-check coverage, which is explicitly contraindicated. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not supported: ci_history is workflow-level with a multi-day outlier and no representative per-job successful-duration history, and imposing a timeout risks failing valid slow or cold tox runs. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is not applied because the coveralls parallel/finish contract and required-check semantics are unverified, and canceling in-progress compatibility runs could prematurely finalize coverage reporting.
